common.slogan: Empowering Sri Lankan Workers & Local Entrepreneurs

auth.termsConsent: I agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Notice for identity verification and platform usage.

home.heroEyebrow: A place for Sri Lankan talent to grow
home.heroDescription: Discover meaningful work, connect with skilled people, and explore ways to grow a small business all in one place.
home.opportunitiesDescription: Whether you are looking for work, building a team, or growing a business, find a starting point here.
home.featureJobsText: Explore open roles and take the next step in your working life.
home.featureHiringText: Share an opening and connect with people ready to contribute.
home.featureBusinessText: Shape your idea into a proposal and make it visible to funders.
home.featureFundingText: Discover community business proposals and express your interest.
home.featureTrainingText: Find opportunities to develop practical and professional skills.
home.featureNearbyText: Browse work opportunities around your district and location.
home.stepsTitle: A few steps to get started
home.stepsDescription: Create a profile, find what fits, and connect with the people who can help you move forward.
home.step1Text: Choose the role that best describes what you want to do.
home.step2Text: Share your skills, experience, or business idea.
home.step3Text: Search jobs and proposals across the platform.
home.step4Text: Reach out, submit an application, or express interest.
home.step5Text: Keep building your career or business, one step at a time.
home.jobsDescription: Recent openings from employers on the platform. Explore the full list to find a role that fits.
home.noOpenJobs: There are no open roles to feature right now.
home.fundingTitle: Ideas grow stronger when the right people can see them.
home.fundingDescription: Entrepreneurs can share business proposals and funding needs. Funders can discover projects and express interest. Any financing arrangements take place outside the platform.
home.languageDescription: Choose English, Sinhala, or Tamil as you explore. The platform’s translation support helps make job posts and conversations more accessible across languages.
home.finalDescription: Explore jobs, share your experience, or take the first step towards building a business.

verification.title: Identity & Business Verification
verification.subtitle: Submit your Sri Lankan National Identity Card (NIC) and documents to earn the Verified badge.
verification.nicNumber: NIC Number (Old: 9 digits + V/X, or New: 12 digits)
verification.dobCheckNotice: Automatic system validation verifies that the date of birth encoded in your NIC matches your profile date of birth.
verification.dobMatchSuccess: NIC Date of Birth matched successfully.
verification.dobMatchFailed: NIC Date of Birth does not match entered date of birth.
verification.encryptionNotice: Your NIC number is encrypted at rest using AES-256-GCM. It is only accessible to authorized verifiers and admins.

jobs.title: Available Jobs Across Sri Lanka
jobs.searchPlaceholder: Search jobs by title or skills...
jobs.signInToApply: Sign in as a Job Seeker to apply
jobs.guestNotice: Guests see limited job information. Sign in to see employer contact and apply.
jobs.alreadyApplied: You have already applied for this job.

pitches.title: Micro-Business Funding Pitches
pitches.subtitle: Discover grassroots Sri Lankan micro-businesses seeking micro-loans and grants. No money movement takes place on this platform.
pitches.pledgeSuccess: Your funding interest has been registered. The entrepreneur has been notified!

geo.title: Nearby Jobs Matching
geo.subtitle: Jobs near your home or business location sorted by distance using geospatial calculations.
geo.privacyNotice: For your safety, exact coordinates are never revealed to other users or public visitors.

inbox.title: Messages & In-App Translation
inbox.typeMessage: Type a message in your language...
inbox.autoTranslateNotice: Messages are automatically translated into your preferred language with the original message shown beside it.

funders.title: Funder Directory
funders.description: Discover verified funders who have chosen to be listed.
funders.accessDenied: The funder directory is not available to this account.
funders.listMe: List me in the funder directory
funders.listingNote: Only active, verified funders are shown in directory results.
